why: The shopper asked for one component, and ChatGPT answered with standalone all-in-one inverters (EG4 6000XP, Growatt SPF 5000, Growatt SPE 6000) without naming any item that must be added; the battery-voltage and solar-input points were things to check before buying, not extra purchases.
